question: Why was Qāsim-i Anvār caught in the same 1427 action as Ibn Turka?
proposition: The Hurufi link was the official excuse, while Ismaʿili claims on him and the general targeting of extra-establishment figures were the deeper suspicion.
reasoning: MK's footnote after Virani: Ismaʿilis apparently claimed him; his putative Hurufi link supplied the official excuse.
Qāsim's disciples were in ill repute (Bashir); MK also notes the Ṣafavī past but denies active propaganda.
MK's main text explains the purge by Shāhrukh's consolidation rather than by Qāsim's own doctrine.
